content.thinking:
I need to write the paragraph while keeping to the rule of no figures, using the {duration} and {customer_loss} placeholders. Saying nobody was paged is a plain statement and fits. Words like "far more" would size a figure, so I'll write "more purchases than usual" instead, and use plain "more" for the cause as well.

I'm keeping the affected purchases vague: some were held, with the likely rounding kept hedged. For the resolution, the pods are held to one card type with automatic sync off, and a draft fix is open but not applied. The customer loss goes in as the {customer_loss} estimate.

input.overview: For {duration}, the io-shop held more purchases for fraud review than usual, so some customers' purchases were held back. One copy of the shop's service had started on a different kind of graphics card from the others. On that card, the fraud check likely rounds its numbers coarsely enough to change its decisions, which is why it held more purchases for review. Argus estimates the cost to the shop in takings at {customer_loss}. Nobody was paged, and no on-call incident was linked to this one. To end it, Argus kept all of the shop's copies on the same kind of graphics card as the others, the Tesla-V100-SXM2-16GB. Argus confirmed this change, which is still in place, and left automatic syncing off so the change isn't undone. Argus has also proposed a lasting fix, PR #534, but it is only a draft and has not been applied.
